purpose: Isolated retrospective public-data comparison plus prospective fixed analytic initial-condition suite; no production code edits
public_label: retrospective; all final segments previously viewed
public_representation: unchanged integrated regression; one original trajectory only
analytic_row_budget: Within each derivative backend: B=3*floor(minimum training trajectory rows/3), both single and joint use B total rows; deterministic linspace index selection; equal trajectory weights
analytic_derivative_scope: Pointwise exact versus estimated contrasts analytic derivatives with numerical differentiation AND spectral field/library projection; Cole-Hopf is not strictly band-limited. Integrated versus pointwise additionally changes regression form. Exact is privileged analytical input, not observable deployment performance. All fields are analytically generated, not measurements.
selection: Per-method development sqrt(mean(per-trajectory MSE)), <=1.05*best +1e-12 then fewest terms, RMSE, deterministic candidate_id
final_guard: All 63 unique predeclared model identities and matching metadata must be frozen before final arrays generated/read or scoring references parsed. Production baseline archives remain unchanged.

gate.no_gain_action: do not merge, keep unchanged original project as active baseline
gate.interpretation: engineering acceptance gate, not statistical significance; old public datasets remain retrospective

scope_limits: no coefficient threshold changes after viewing results
